If sludge is present, perform a careful chemical flush or remove the head/pan for cleaning. For head gasket replacement, respect head-surface finish limits and bolt-torque specs — the Fire 16V steel gasket leaks if the resurfaced finish is out of spec.

Document the failure and pursue Fiat/consumer channels if the car is low-mileage.

Address leaks promptly — standing moisture causes mold, odors and electrical connector corrosion under the carpet.

rows.title: Electrical System Faults: Infotainment Freezes, Rapid Battery Discharge and Start-Stop Failure
rows.howToFix: Apply the latest Uconnect/module software updates at a Fiat dealer — Fiat has released updates addressing multimedia freezing. Have the battery load-tested and replaced with a correct-spec (or higher-capacity) AGM/EFB unit if weak, since most start-stop and module misbehavior traces back to low voltage; the start-stop system also requires a battery registered/coded to spec to resume working. For vehicles that sit unused, a smart trickle charger prevents the rapid-discharge complaints. Persistent gremlins after battery and software service warrant a parasitic-draw test and inspection of grounds and the body control module.

rows.title: Transmission Heat Exchanger Failure Causing Coolant and Transmission Fluid Cross-Contamination
rows.howToFix: If caught early (oil in the coolant reservoir but no coolant in the transmission), replace the heat exchanger and flush the cooling system. If coolant has entered the transmission, the transmission must be disassembled, cleaned and rebuilt with new clutches and seals, plus a new heat exchanger. Brazilian specialists recommend preventive coolant replacement every 40,000 km (far earlier than the factory 240,000 km interval) using the correct para-flu additive ratio, and many shops offer a conversion kit replacing the exchanger with a larger air-cooled external transmission oil radiator (similar to the diesel AT9 setup), which lowers ATF temperature 10-15°C and removes the contamination path entirely.

rows.howToFix: Have the battery's state of health and charge tested with proper equipment. If degraded, replace it with an EFB (or AGM) battery of the correct specification — a conventional flooded battery will cause the warning to return and ages rapidly under stop-start cycling.
